name: Template Delivery PDF Checker
summary: Check a template delivery PDF for missing, duplicate, malformed, and risky Canva links before a buyer receives it.
customer: Solo Etsy or Gumroad sellers who deliver editable Canva templates through downloadable PDF files.
problem: A delivery PDF can look correct while containing no clickable link, a duplicated or malformed target, or a Canva view/edit link that exposes the seller's master instead of opening a buyer-safe template flow.
solution: A downloadable offline browser utility that reads PDF link annotations locally, classifies Canva and external targets, overlays every clickable region, surfaces warnings, and exports a QA report.

acceptance_checks.description: A three-link fixture produces exactly three rows with correct pages, URLs, and categories.
The utility warns for zero annotations, non-HTTPS or malformed targets, duplicates, and risky Canva links.
The preview exposes one visible overlay for every detected link rectangle on the selected page.
Markdown and CSV exports include file metadata, category counts, rows, and all displayed warnings.
The built app loads and analyzes a fixture with the network disabled and makes no outbound request.
An 18-profile annotation corpus plus a real Chrome print-to-PDF export covers URI encodings, Canva patterns, internal destinations, and active-content targets.
File, page, and link limits, cancellation, damaged PDFs, password errors, and parser failures produce bounded behavior and customer-facing messages.
Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and WebKit load from file://, remain network-isolated, analyze the fixture, render overlays, and download verified Markdown and CSV reports.
The release ZIP contains only intended assets, disables PDF JavaScript evaluation, enforces a restrictive CSP, contains no source map, and stays below 10 MB.
The product pull request passes the manifest validator and the product-specific clean install, unit/PDF/release, and Chromium browser jobs on GitHub Actions.
Deterministic sanitized fixtures generate four 1600x900 buyer-facing evidence images plus exact sample Markdown and CSV reports without customer, payment, or confidential data.
The trust uplift leaves the published v1.0.0 ZIP unchanged at SHA-256 a035efc717ff96bfed1071adae526d48fad5ffb448edbfdaa8d7584053106221.
